Resolves #21190

Related: #21175 · #21142 · #21140
Companion cover PR: https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/120

Adds `examples/grid/streaming/` (`Neo.examples.grid.streaming.*`), demonstrating progressive 50,000-row NDJSON streaming into a virtualized Neo grid. A seeded in-example `StreamConnection` (`createSeededRandom(21190)`) feeds `Neo.data.parser.Stream` with an initial 250-row batch (`initialDelay: 45`) followed by 2,500-row chunks every 120 ms (`chunkDelay: 120`), while a custom `FooterToolbar` overrides `onStoreProgress(data)` and listens to store `mutate` events to drive a live row counter (`"Streaming X / 50,000 rows"` -> `"50,000 / 50,000 rows"`), `<progress>` bar, abort-and-restart `"Load again"` cycle, and single-line header prompt (`"Scroll while rows arrive. Load again clears and replays all 50,000 rows."`), alongside the portal `grid-streaming` catalog entry, capture recipe, `seo.json` update, and rebased catalog count assertions (`117` catalog records, `98` published / `97` devmode across `21` groups, `19` covered in `Grid & Table`).

Evidence: L4 (Playwright unit + whitebox E2E + live devmode visual capture at 1440×900 & 390×844 across light/dark themes + full-page Portal `Grid & Table` released/changed pair at 1280 px) → L4 required (AC-1..AC-9).

## Deltas from ticket

- Subscribed `FooterToolbar.beforeSetStore` to the store's `mutate` event (`onStoreMutate`) in addition to overriding `onStoreProgress(data)` so `store.clear()` immediately resets the footer counter and `<progress>` bar to `0` before the first chunk of a `"Load again"` run arrives.
